Hi Alex and Samira —

Thanks again for agreeing to the technical deep-dive. We want to lock in a 90–120 minute session that includes: architecture walkthrough, end-to-end request path, and a short live perf demo. Given architect availability across US/EU/APAC and the upcoming DST changes, I put together a small overlap matrix and a proposed rotating schedule to avoid repeatedly asking the same folks to join outside business hours.

Attached: deep-dive-agenda-v2.pdf and overlap-matrix-raw.csv (raw timeslots by timezone).

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the two Globex architects who will attend (I have Alex and Samira listed)?
- Which of these 4 candidate windows work for you (times shown in your local time in the attached matrix):
  1) US morning / EU late afternoon (PDT 08:00 / CET 17:00)
  2) EU morning / APAC afternoon (CET 09:30 / JST 17:30)
  3) Short slot at the US end-of-day / APAC morning overlap (PDT 16:00 / JST 08:00 next day — shorter, 60 min)
  4) Rotating weekly slot (we propose rotating between 1 and 2 for ongoing cadence)

Note on DST: US shifts earlier in March this year; EU shifts later in March — so the windows shift by an hour for a couple of weeks. I call that out in the matrix and suggest we pick a DST-aware anchor (UTC 15:00 for example) and display local times in calendar invites.

If you prefer, we can run a poll and I’ll set the calendar invite with explicit timezone labels.

Thanks — I can be flexible on final timing and will coordinate with Karthik for the live perf demo.
